body:
### Summary

I built (using pkgsrc) a package (maturin), correctly tagged with my OS version (NetBSD 11 on x86_64).
However, UV thinks that this package does not fit my platform 

```bash 
nbsd01_at_vf7$ uv pip install ~/pkgsrc/devel/py-maturin/work/maturin-1.15.0/dist/maturin-1.15.0-cp314-cp314-netbsd_11_0_stable_amd64.whl
Resolved 1 package in 17ms
error: Failed to determine installation plan
  Caused by: A path (/home/usr01/pkgsrc/devel/py-maturin/work/maturin-1.15.0/dist/maturin-1.15.0-cp314-cp314-netbsd_11_0_stable_amd64.whl)
             dependency is incompatible with the current platform

hint: The wheel is compatible with NetBSD (`netbsd_11_0_stable_amd64`), but you're on NetBSD (`netbsd_11_0_STABLE_amd64`)

```

It seems that (this is now according to AI), that in FreeBSD implementation of UV there is a tolowercase() to normalize case to lower, but on NetBSD this is not implemented (and I appologise that I did not check this personally, just relating what ai told me when I asked if this has been fixed upstream already)



### Platform

NetBSD 11

### Version

uv 0.12.13 (x86_64-unknown-netbsd)

### Python version

Python 3.14.6
title: uv rejects a wheel package built locally, because it uses case-sensitive compare for NetBSD tag
